name: The Upanishads
translation: Principal Upanishads — Swami Nikhilananda & Max Müller

verses.text: All this, whatsoever moves in this moving world, is enveloped by the Divine. Find your enjoyment in renunciation; covet not the wealth of any person.
verses.original: ॐ ईशा वास्यमिदँ सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् । तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम् ॥
verses.transliteration: Oṁ īśā vāsyam idaṁ sarvaṁ yat kiñca jagatyāṁ jagat...

verses.text: He who sees all beings in the Self alone, and the Self in all beings, feels no hatred by virtue of that realization.
verses.original: यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मन्येवानुपश्यति । सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ततो न विजुगुप्सते ॥

verses.text: When to the seer all things have verily become the Self, what delusion, what sorrow can there be for him who beholds that oneness?
verses.original: यस्मिन्सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मैवाभूद्विजानतः । तत्र को मोहः कः शोक एकत्वमनुपश्यतः ॥

chapters.name: Katha Upanishad
chapters.subtitle: Nachiketa and Yama: The secret of immortality

verses.text: The good is one thing, the pleasant another; these two, having different purposes, bind human beings. Of these two, it is well for him who chooses the good; he who chooses the pleasant misses the true goal.
verses.original: अन्यच्छ्रेयोऽन्यदुतैव प्रेयस्ते उभे नानार्थे पुरुषँ सिनीतः । तयोः श्रेय आददानस्य साधु भवति हीयतेऽर्थाद्य उ प्रेयो वृणीते ॥

verses.text: Arise, awake, and learn by approaching the wise! Sharp as the edge of a razor and hard to cross, say the sages, is this path.
verses.original: उत्तिष्ठत जाग्रत प्राप्य वरान्निबोधत । क्षुरस्य धारा निशिता दुरत्यया दुर्गं पथस्तत्कवयो वदन्ति ॥

verses.text: Knowing that which is soundless, touchless, formless, undecaying, tasteless, eternal, odorless, without beginning and without end, beyond the great — one is freed from the jaws of death.
verses.original: अशब्दमस्पर्शमरूपमव्ययं तथाऽरसं नित्यमगन्धवच्च यत् । अनाद्यनन्तं महतः परं ध्रुवं निचाय्य तन्मृत्युमुखात् प्रमुच्यते ॥

chapters.name: Mundaka & Mandukya Upanishads
chapters.subtitle: Truth alone triumphs (Satyameva Jayate) and the nature of OM

verses.text: Truth alone triumphs, not untruth. By truth is paved the divine path along which the sages, having their desires fulfilled, proceed to the supreme abode of Truth.
verses.original: सत्यमेव जयते नानृतं सत्येन पन्था विततो देवयानः । येनाक्रमन्त्यृषयो ह्याप्तकामा यत्र तत् सत्यस्य परमं निधानम् ॥

verses.text: OM — this syllable is all this. All that was, that is, and that will be is verily OM; and whatever is beyond the threefold time is also verily OM.
verses.original: ओमित्येतदक्षरमिदँ सर्वं तस्योपव्याख्यानं भूतं भवद् भविष्यदिति सर्वमोङ्कार एव । यच्चान्यत् त्रिकालातीतं तदपि ओङ्कार एव ॥
verses.transliteration: Om ity etad akṣaram idaṁ sarvam...
